MUS.note: A one-time password on an application form only; no ID authentication service.
Bank account guidance for disabled youths only; no digital accessibility measure.
No enrolment count or share stated.
Application asks for the card number, but no register is said to be keyed on it.
Nothing on the ID system itself.

facts.fact: The Mauritius Revenue Authority says the Independence Allowance of Rs 20,000 is paid to eligible youths registered on the Social Register of Mauritius on reaching 18.
